title: Anthropic Delayed Next Frontier AI Model Training for More Than a Month
summary:
A filing for an initial public offering reveals that the AI developer halted the pre-training of its newest frontier model to implement strengthened defenses against the theft of model weights. The company postponed the training process for more than 30 days to prioritize these security improvements.

Anthropic warned in the document that pausing training for security reasons could cause the company to lose ground to its competitors and may negatively impact its revenue.
